findings.message: app_service_plan_id requires manual review in v5: app_service_plan_id now validates its value as an App Service Plan ID (case-sensitive) in v5; confirm the value is a correctly-cased Resource Manager ID
v5 changes the default of client_certificate_mode to 'Required'; set it explicitly to preserve v4 behavior
min_tls_version is set to "1.1", which is no longer accepted in v5; choose a replacement value

public_network_access_enabled requires manual review in v5: the deprecated site_config.public_network_access_enabled (bool) was removed in v5 in favour of the top-level public_network_access (string: Enabled/Disabled); this is a type and location change, migrate manually
scm_min_tls_version is set to "1.0", which is no longer accepted in v5; choose a replacement value
